question:
**Direction: Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.**

Mothers can pass the HIV virus to their newborns during delivery as well, WHO says.

options.text: Mothers can pass the HIV virus to

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"as well, WHO says."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the phrase** "as well"** is in addition; too. (इसके अलावा; बहुत)

 
 
• **Example**: *The museum provides hours of fun and a few surprises **as well**__.*
 
 
 
• The phrase **"as well"** is not necessary in the sentence and creates a grammatical error.
 
• The correct phrasing should be *"Mothers can pass the HIV virus to their newborns during delivery, WHO says."*

The correct answer is** Option 1.**
